items.title: Sidney Desvigne Interview, 1958-08-18
items.q: I have 11 men in the band... we had some guy by the name of Slim John or something. He played the accordion... So we had an hour to play, and they would play an hour.

ctx.x: I have 11 men in the band, and it's a big dance. And we had some guy by the name of Slim John or something. He played the accordion, that hillbilly stuff, you know. So we had an hour to play, and they would play an hour. So we started off playing our first hour. People were all crowded around the place, but nobody wouldn't dance. The kind of stuff we were putting out, they just didn't like that. So after our hour was up, and this band played, boy, the first number they hit, one of them old quadrille, little…

Speaking of trombone, I wonder if you could talk just for a minute or two about trombone players. Who was your favorite trombone player? You mentioned much George Field, but of all the different trombonists you've heard or worked with, who were some of the greatest that you remember? The best ones, or your favorites, you might say. Either people that worked with you or others that you heard when you were a kid?
